Res.Caption: Agents Reference
Res.FullDescription: Agent's or Consignee's Reference.

Res.Caption: Consol Type
Res.FullDescription: The Type of Consolidation.

Res.Caption: Service Level
Res.FullDescription: The carrier service level for this consolidation.

Res.Caption: Carrier Bkg. Ref
Res.FullDescription:
Enter the Booking Reference from the line for this Consol.
When you make a consol booking with an air or sea freight line.

Res.Caption: Carrier Contract Number
Res.FullDescription: Enter the Carrier Contract Number from the line for this Consol.

Res.Caption: Allocation ID
Res.FullDescription: ID of the Allocation Route under a Carrier Contract that current Consol is assigned to.

Res.Caption: Consolidated Chargeable Quantity
Res.FullDescription: Total Chargeable of Shipments attached to the Consol.

Res.Caption: Total Shipment Weight
Res.FullDescription: The total shipment weight of this consolidation.

Res.Caption: Total Shipment Volume
Res.FullDescription: The total shipment volume of this consolidation.

Res.Caption: Chargeable Rate
Res.FullDescription: Chargeable Freight Rate used on AWB

Res.Caption: Consol Cut Off Date
Res.FullDescription: Supervisor access is required to add or remove Shipments to / from the Consol after this date.

Res.Caption: Container Mode
Res.FullDescription: The Container Packing Mode of Consolidation.

Res.Caption: Freight Cost/MB Chargeable
Res.FullDescription: Cost per Unit MBL - Freight Cost per Consolidated Chargeable Unit = Total Consol Local Cost of Freight Group Consol Level Charges/Consol Chargeable Unit.

Res.Caption: Freight Cost/HB Chargeable
Res.FullDescription: Cost per Unit HBL - Freight Cost per Total Shipment Chargeable Unit = Total Consol Local Cost of Freight Group Consol Level Charges/Sum of House Bill Chargeable Unit.

Res.Caption: Consolidated Volume
Res.FullDescription: Total Volume of Shipments attached to the Consol.

Res.Caption: Consolidated Weight
Res.FullDescription: Total Weight of Shipments attached to the Consol.

Res.Caption: Is Neutral Master
Res.FullDescription:
This indicates whether the MAWB is a Neutral MAWB or not. If this box is not ticked, then the assumption is that the MAWB is a Carrier MAWB. It is a CASS requirement that all Neutral MAWBs be added to stock before they are used on a Consol.
MAWBs can be added to stock by entering them under Reference Files | MAWB Stock.

Res.Caption: Copy BOL's
Res.FullDescription: Number of Copy Bills of Lading.

Res.Caption: Original Bills
Res.FullDescription: Number of Original Bills of Lading.

Res.Caption: Receiving Agent
Res.FullDescription:
Enter the agent at the discharge port (Destination).
Generally, but not always, either the Sending or Receiving agent will be the organization that you are working in.
If appropriate, this field will default based on the type of shipment you are working on.

Res.Caption: Sending Agent
Res.FullDescription:
Enter the agent at the loading port (Origin).
Generally, but not always, either the Sending or Receiving agent will be the organization that you are working in.
If appropriate, this field will default based on the type of shipment you are working on.

Res.Caption: Carrier
Res.FullDescription: The shipping line that will move this consol.

Res.Caption: Creditor/Co-Loader
Res.FullDescription:
Coload Agent if the Consol Type is a Co-Load.
A co loader is a forwarder that you use if your organization has chosen not to cut their own direct bill or consol.
If your organization is not using a co loader as an Agent Type, this will be a read only field.

Res.Caption: Payment Type
Res.FullDescription: Indicate if charges are Prepaid (PPD) or Collect (CCX).

Res.Caption: Print Option for Manifest
Res.FullDescription: Select whether to print Masters only, Sub House bills only or both.

Res.Caption: Other Docs Print
Res.FullDescription: Select whether to print Masters only, Sub House Bills only or both.

Res.Caption: AWB Dimensions
Res.FullDescription: This selection of this value governs how the volume and dimensions are defaulted to the 'Nature and Quantity of Goods' section on the Air Waybill

Res.Caption: Final Discharge Port
Res.FullDescription: The final discharge of the consol, usually where the consol is broken up.

Res.Caption: First Load Port
Res.FullDescription: The consol's first load port, usually where the consol is consolidated.

Res.Caption: Total Shipment Chargeable Quantity
Res.FullDescription: The total shipment chargeable quantity of this consolidation.

Res.Caption: Transport Mode
Res.FullDescription: Main Transport Mode of Consolidation.

Res.Caption: Co-Load Master Bill
Res.FullDescription: Enter Co-Load Master Bill

Res.Caption: Co-Load Booking Reference
Res.FullDescription: Enter Co-Load Booking Reference

Res.Caption: Cost Free Units
Res.FullDescription: (Sum of Shipments attached to Consol's Chargeable Units) – (Consol's Chargeable Units)

Res.Caption: Receipt Requested
Res.FullDescription: The requested receipt date for the packing depot.

Res.Caption: Dispatch Requested
Res.FullDescription: The requested dispatch date for the packing depot.

Res.Caption: Receipt Requested
Res.FullDescription: The requested receipt date for the unpacking depot.

Res.Caption: Dispatch Requested
Res.FullDescription: The requested dispatch date for the packing depot.
